verdict.rationale: Foreloop exposes an official CLI, a JS feedback SDK (initForeloopFeedback), and an MCP endpoint for agent clients, giving AI-native builders official integration surfaces beyond just docs. However, this is all first-party vendor documentation with no independent corroboration or SDK versioning/language-coverage details (e.g. only JS snippet shown, no Python/other language SDKs). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of SDK usage, multi-language SDK coverage, and evidence of SDK stability/versioning beyond the JS snippet.
